svg.title: Altered level of consciousness: treat the reversible causes first, then the exam (brainstem reflexes, breathing, motor response, eye opening and signs of awareness) places the patient as brain death, coma, vegetative state, minimally conscious state minus or plus, or a locked-in coma mimic

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: Not responding: FIRST look for the TREATABLE causes

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: shock or low blood pressure · low glucose · diabetic ketoacidosis · hypertensive encephalopathy · drug intoxication

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: bacterial or fungal meningitis · herpes simplex encephalitis · brain abscess · epidural or subdural hematoma

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: then EXAMINE: is the patient AWAKE (alertness) and AWARE (awareness)?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: brainstem reflexes and eye opening decide
